name: AgentContextFrame<Active>::prompt_binding

test_list.description: A binding created from an active frame exposes that frame's id, root id, role, selected model, and selected effort through read-only getters.
A child binding preserves the root frame id while retaining its own frame id and selected model; an unrelated frame retains its own identity and selection.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.description: An actual active frame with model and effort selected during activation.

output_description: A sealed, secret-free binding whose private fields associate frame identity, role, selected model, and effort; missing model state reports the existing accounting invariant error.
